name: zopt_set_wol_password_flag
description: zOpt::SetWolPasswordFlag stores the WOL password-save flag through the recovered option pointer.
known_limits: Functional target shares a smoke with zOpt_GetWolPasswordFlagValue because the meaningful isolated behavior is setter/getter access to the same recovered option pointer.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x408a10 validates a fastcall void setter that loads g_zOpt_WolPasswordFlagOption and stores the ECX value through that pointer.

Native smoke zopt_wol_password_flag_accessor_smoke redirects g_zOpt_WolPasswordFlagOption to a local integer, calls zOpt::SetWolPasswordFlag with enabled and disabled values, and verifies the stored values through zOpt_GetWolPasswordFlagValue.
